about: Rule-based (deterministic) explanations of the Factoidal rewrites of Martin Poulter's Wikidata queries. No language model is used.
parser: factoidal Lean parser L4Factoidal.Wikidata.parseQuerySyntax via an interim JSON export; to be replaced by parseSparqlAst

byBlocker.blocker: OR whose branches are not single facet conditions
join on a computed value, or unconnected sets
cyclic join (not a tree from one set)
negation tied to two columns (correlated, not one facet)
subquery that is not set browsing (any property (unrestricted variable predicate))
negated combination "not (A and B)" — reads ambiguously as a facet
negation of a complex property path
subquery that is not set browsing (union inside OPTIONAL)
negated chain of 3 hops (too deep for one facet)

queries.title: All Wikidata properties with label and description, ordered numerically
section: All Wikidata properties with label and description, ordered numerically
queries.rewritten:
#title:Wikidata properties in numerical order
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT  ?property ?propertyType ?propertyLabel ?propertyDescription
WHERE
  { ?property  wikibase:propertyType  ?propertyType
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  rdfs:label  ?property__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  rdfs:label  ?property__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?property__label_value), ?property__label_value, if(( isURI(?property) && strstarts(str(?property), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?property), "entity/"), str(?property))) AS ?propertyLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?property  schema:description  ?property__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?property__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?property__description_value AS ?propertyDescription)
  }
ORDER BY ASC(xsd:integer(strafter(str(?property), "P")))
queries.titleDirective: Wikidata properties in numerical order
queries.explanation:
Columns:
  ?property: always has a value
  ?propertyType: always has a value
  ?propertyLabel: the label of ?property in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?propertyDescription: the description of ?property in the first of en that has one; blank otherwise
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?property property datatype (wikibase:propertyType) ?propertyType  [R-TRIPLE]
Order: the part of the text of ?property after "P" as an integer ascending.
Labels: ?propertyLabel from en → mul → ID.
Translation: rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.

queries.title: Variation of the above excluding external IDs (thanks Magnus Sälgö)
section: Variation of the above excluding external IDs (thanks Magnus Sälgö)
queries.rewritten:
#title:Wikidata properties excluding external IDs
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>
PREFIX  xsd:  <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT  ?id ?idLabel ?idDescription ?new
WHERE
  { ?id  wikibase:directClaim  ?pid
    MINUS
      { ?id  wikibase:propertyType  wikibase:ExternalId }
    BIND(replace(str(?id), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/P", " ") AS ?new)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?id  rdfs:label  ?id__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?id__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?id  rdfs:label  ?id__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?id__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?id__label_value), ?id__label_value, if(( isURI(?id) && strstarts(str(?id), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?id), "entity/"), str(?id))) AS ?idLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?id  schema:description  ?id__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?id__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?id__description_value AS ?idDescription)
  }
ORDER BY DESC(xsd:integer(?new))

negations: exclude: property datatype (wikibase:propertyType) includes wikibase:ExternalId

queries.titleDirective: Wikidata properties excluding external IDs
queries.explanation:
Columns:
  ?id: always has a value
  ?idLabel: the label of ?id in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?idDescription: the description of ?id in the first of en that has one; blank otherwise
  ?new: may be blank
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?id direct-claim predicate (wikibase:directClaim) ?pid  [R-TRIPLE]
  - ?new is the text of ?id with every match of the regular expression "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/P" replaced by " "  [R-BIND]
Excluded:
  - excludes any result for which [?id property datatype (wikibase:propertyType) wikibase:ExternalId] also holds, matching on ?id  [R-MINUS]
Order: ?new as an integer descending.
Caveats:
  * [display] Rows where ?new as an integer is blank sort last.  (R-ORDER-UNBOUND)
Labels: ?idLabel from en → mul → ID.

queries.title: Count of scientific articles
queries.explanation:
The result is a single row.
Columns:
  ?count: the number of ?article
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?article is an instance of scholarly article (Q13442814 — article in an academic publication, usually peer reviewed) or of any subclass of it  [R-SUBCLASS]
Grouping: all rows form one group.
Caveats:
  * [changes_answer] ?count counts matching rows, not distinct ?article. ?article is counted once for each intermediate value along wdt:P31/wdt:P279* (R-MULT-PATH).  (R-COUNT-ROWS)
  * [scope] ?article is an instance of scholarly article (Q13442814) or of any class that is, through any chain of "subclass of" links, a subclass of scholarly article (Q13442814).  (R-SUBCLASS)
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of instance of (P31), subclass of (P279): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)

queries.title: Count of labels for a given item, broken down by language
section: Count of labels for a given item, broken down by language
queries.rewritten:
#title:Number of labels for an item, split by language
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?q ?langcode ?langLabel (COUNT(?label) AS ?count)
WHERE
  { VALUES ?q { wd:Q43459 }
    ?q rdfs:label|skos:altLabel ?label
    BIND(lang(?label) AS ?langcode)
    ?lang  wdt:P218  ?langcode
    OPTIONAL
      { ?lang  rdfs:label  ?lang__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?lang__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?lang  rdfs:label  ?lang__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?lang__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?lang__label_value), ?lang__label_value, if(( isURI(?lang) && strstarts(str(?lang), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?lang), "entity/"), str(?lang))) AS ?langLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?q ?langcode ?langLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)

blockers: join on a computed value, or unconnected sets

queries.titleDirective: Number of labels for an item, split by language
queries.explanation:
One row per distinct combination of ?q, ?langcode, ?langLabel.
Columns:
  ?q: always has a value
  ?langcode: always has a value
  ?langLabel: the label of ?lang in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?count: the number of ?label
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?q takes each of: Ferdowsi (Q43459 — Persian poet, author of Shahnameh (940–1020))  [R-VALUES]
  - ?q reaches ?label via (rdfs:label|skos:altLabel)  [R-PATH]
  - ?langcode is the language tag of ?label  [R-BIND]
  - ?lang has ISO 639-1 code (P218) ?langcode  [R-TRUTHY]
Grouping: by ?q, ?langcode, ?langLabel.
Order: ?count descending.
Caveats:
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?q, ?langcode, ?langLabel, so a ?q with several ?langcode values appears once for each.  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?q, ?langcode, ?langLabel, so a ?q with several ?lang values appears once for each (each distinct ?langLabel).  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping includes the label column ?langLabel; things with identical labels are merged into one group.  (R-GROUP-BY-LABEL)
  * [changes_answer] ?count counts matching rows, not distinct ?label. ?label is counted once for each matching ?lang (R-MULT-VALUE).  (R-COUNT-ROWS)
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of ISO 639-1 code (P218): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)
Labels: ?langLabel from en → mul → ID.
Translation: rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic; When tested on 2026-11-24, this version returned 83 rows against 83 for the original, and the rows did not match..

queries.title: Counting stuff on Wikidata · Women born in the UK
queries.rewritten:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?p ?pLabel ?pDescription
WHERE
  { ?p  wdt:P31  wd:Q5 ;
        wdt:P21  wd:Q6581072
      { ?p  wdt:P19  wd:Q145 }
    UNION
      { ?p  wdt:P19  ?place
          { ?place (wdt:P131)?/wdt:P17 wd:Q145 }
        UNION
          { ?place ((wdt:P131)*/(wdt:P17)?)/wdt:P31 wd:Q3336843 }
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?p  rdfs:label  ?p__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?p__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?p  rdfs:label  ?p__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?p__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?p__label_value), ?p__label_value, if(( isURI(?p) && strstarts(str(?p), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?p), "entity/"), str(?p))) AS ?pLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?p  schema:description  ?p__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?p__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?p__description_value AS ?pDescription)
  }
ORDER BY ?pLabel

blockers: OR whose branches are not single facet conditions

queries.explanation:
Columns:
  ?p: always has a value
  ?pLabel: the label of ?p in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?pDescription: the description of ?p in the first of en that has one; blank otherwise
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?p has instance of (P31) human (Q5 — any single member of Homo sapiens, unique extant species of the genus Homo)  [R-TRUTHY]
  - ?p has sex or gender (P21) female (Q6581072 — to be used in "sex or gender" (P21) to indicate that the human subject is a female or "semantic gender" (P10339) to indicate that a word refers to a female person)  [R-TRUTHY]
  - either [?p has place of birth (P19) United Kingdom (Q145 — island country in north-west Europe)] or [?p has place of birth (P19) ?place; either [?place reaches United Kingdom (Q145) by following wdt:P131?/wdt:P17 (each step a separate link)] or [?place reaches constituent country of the United Kingdom (Q3336843 — one of four constituent countries of the United Kingdom: England, Wales, Scotland and Northern Ireland) by following wdt:P131*/wdt:P17?/wdt:P31 (each step a separate link)]]  [R-UNION]
Order: ?pLabel ascending.
Rows are deduplicated (DISTINCT).
Caveats:
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of instance of (P31), sex or gender (P21), place of birth (P19), located in the administrative territorial entity (P131), country (P17): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)
Labels: ?pLabel from en → mul → ID.
Author notes:
  "place of birth: UK"  — after: {?p wdt:P19 wd:Q145}
  "places whose country is the UK"  — after: { ?place wdt:P131?/wdt:P17 wd:Q145 }
  "places whose country is a constituent of the UK"  — after: { ?place wdt:P131*/wdt:P17?/wdt:P31 wd:Q3336843 }
Translation: rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.

queries.title: Wikipedia articles about works
queries.explanation:
Columns:
  ?work: always has a value
  ?title: may be blank
  ?year: may be blank
  ?english: may be blank
  ?french: may be blank
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?work has author (P50) Voltaire (Q9068 — French writer, historian and philosopher (1694–1778))  [R-TRUTHY]
  - ?year is the year of ?pubdate  [R-BIND]
Optional:
  - ?pubdate filled in if ?work has publication date (P577) ?pubdate, otherwise left blank  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?english filled in if ?english is a wiki page about ?work; wiki page ?english is on <https://en.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?french filled in if ?french is a wiki page about ?work; wiki page ?french is on <https://fr.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?title filled in if ?title is a label (rdfs:label) of ?work, otherwise left blank (only where the language tag of ?title = "en")  [R-OPTIONAL]
Caveats:
  * [scope] ?year is a year taken from a date. Wikidata dates known only to the year still look like full dates (F-DATE-PRECISION), so the year is reliable but finer parts may not be.  (R-YEAR)
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of author (P50), publication date (P577): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)
  * [scope] A ?work can appear in several rows: once for each value of ?title, ?year.  (R-MULT-PER-ENTITY)
Author notes:
  "OPTIONAL{ ?german schema:about ?work ; schema:isPartOf <https://de.wikipedia.org/> }" (commented-out code)

queries.title: Categorised timeline of works
queries.rewritten:
PREFIX  p:    <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX  psv:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT  ?workLabel ?pubdate ?pubdatePrecision ?image ?typelabel ?english (URI(concat("https://tools.wmflabs.org/reasonator/?q=", substr(str(?work), 32))) AS ?reasonator) (if(bound(?english), ?english, ?reasonator) AS ?link)
WHERE
  { ?work  wdt:P50  wd:Q9068 ;
           wdt:P31  ?type .
    ?work p:P577/psv:P577 ?pubdateStatementNode
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q3331189 }
    MINUS
      { ?work  wdt:P31  wd:Q105420 }
    ?pubdateStatementNode
              wikibase:timeValue    ?pubdate ;
              wikibase:timePrecision  ?pubdatePrecision
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  wdt:P18  ?image }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?english  schema:about     ?work ;
                  schema:isPartOf  <https://en.wikipedia.org/>
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "fr" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "de" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?work  rdfs:label  ?work__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?work__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?work__label_value), ?work__label_value, if(( isURI(?work) && strstarts(str(?work), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?work), "entity/"), str(?work))) AS ?workLabel)
    ?type  rdfs:label  ?typelabel
    FILTER ( lang(?typelabel) = "en" )
  }

negations: exclude: instance of (P31) includes version, edition or translation (Q3331189)
exclude: instance of (P31) includes anthology (Q105420)

queries.explanation:
Columns:
  ?workLabel: the label of ?work in the first of fr, en, de, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?pubdate: always has a value
  ?pubdatePrecision: always has a value
  ?image: may be blank
  ?typelabel: always has a value
  ?english: may be blank
  ?reasonator: the web address (IRI) made from the text "https://tools.wmflabs.org/reasonator/?q=" + the part of the text of ?work starting at character 32 joined together
  ?link: if ?english has a value then ?english else ?reasonator
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?work has author (P50) Voltaire (Q9068 — French writer, historian and philosopher (1694–1778))  [R-TRUTHY]
  - ?work has instance of (P31) ?type  [R-TRUTHY]
  - ?work reaches ?pubdateStatementNode by following p:P577/psv:P577  [R-PATH]
  - ?pubdateStatementNode time value (wikibase:timeValue) ?pubdate  [R-TRIPLE]
  - ?pubdateStatementNode time precision (wikibase:timePrecision) ?pubdatePrecision  [R-TRIPLE]
  - ?typelabel is a label (rdfs:label) of ?type  [R-LABEL]
  - keeps only results where the language tag of ?typelabel = "en"  [R-FILTER]
Optional:
  - ?image filled in if ?work has image (P18) ?image, otherwise left blank  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?english filled in if ?english is a wiki page about ?work; wiki page ?english is on <https://en.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]
Excluded:
  - excludes any result for which [?work has instance of (P31) version, edition or translation (Q3331189 — specific expression (Q111955324) or manifestation (Q111955382) of a work, consisting in its adaptation, edition, or translation (to be used with P31 ["instance of"]))] also holds, matching on ?work  [R-MINUS]
  - excludes any result for which [?work has instance of (P31) anthology (Q105420 — collection of written creative works chosen by the compiler)] also holds, matching on ?work  [R-MINUS]
Caveats:
  * [changes_answer] Identical rows can appear more than once: one for each matching ?work (R-MULT-VALUE), and each instance of (P31) value ?type (R-MULT-VALUE), and each value of ?pubdateStatementNode, and each intermediate value along p:P577/psv:P577 (R-MULT-PATH).  (R-MULT-DUP)
  * [scope] The publication date (P577) statements here are of any rank, including deprecated ones (F-RANK-VALUES).  (R-FULLSTMT)
  * [scope] ?typelabel must have language tag exactly "en"; variants such as "en-gb" and "mul" do not match.  (R-LABEL-EXACT)
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of author (P50), instance of (P31), image (P18): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)
Labels: ?workLabel from fr → en → de → mul → ID.
Author notes:
  "build a reasonator link"  — after: (URI(CONCAT("https://tools.wmflabs.org/reasonator/?q=", SUBSTR(STR(?work),32) )) as ?reasonator)
  "link to English Wikipedia article, if available"  — after: (IF(BOUND(?english), ?english, ?reasonator) as ?link)
  "author: Voltaire"  — after: ?work wdt:P50 wd:Q9068;
  "What is the work? poem, play, historical work etc.?"  — after: wdt:P31 ?type;
  "exclude editions"  — after: MINUS {?work wdt:P31 wd:Q3331189}
  "exclude anthologies"  — after: MINUS {?work wdt:P31 wd:Q105420}
  "get precision of the publication date"  — after: wikibase:timePrecision ?pubdatePrecision

queries.rewritten:
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT  ?player ?playerLabel ?article ?birthyear ?placeLabel
WHERE
  { ?player  wdt:P1303  wd:Q180733
    OPTIONAL
      { ?player  wdt:P569  ?born }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?player  wdt:P19  ?place }
    BIND(year(?born) AS ?birthyear)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?article  schema:about     ?player ;
                  schema:isPartOf  <https://en.wikipedia.org/>
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?player  rdfs:label  ?player__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?player__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?player  rdfs:label  ?player__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?player__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?player__label_value), ?player__label_value, if(( isURI(?player) && strstarts(str(?player), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?player), "entity/"), str(?player))) AS ?playerLabel)
    BIND(if(bound(?place), ?place, "unbound") AS ?place__label_subject)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?place__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?place__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?place__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?place__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?place__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?place__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?place__label_value), ?place__label_value, if(( isURI(?place) && strstarts(str(?place), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?place), "entity/"), str(?place))) AS ?placeLabel)
  }
ORDER BY ASC(?birthyear)
queries.explanation:
Columns:
  ?player: always has a value
  ?playerLabel: the label of ?player in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?article: may be blank
  ?birthyear: may be blank
  ?placeLabel: the label of ?place in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?player has instrument (P1303) lute (Q180733 — musical instrument)  [R-TRUTHY]
  - ?birthyear is the year of ?born  [R-BIND]
Optional:
  - ?born filled in if ?player has date of birth (P569) ?born, otherwise left blank  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?place filled in if ?player has place of birth (P19) ?place, otherwise left blank  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?article filled in if ?article is a wiki page about ?player; wiki page ?article is on <https://en.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]
Order: ?birthyear ascending.
Caveats:
  * [scope] ?birthyear is a year taken from a date. Wikidata dates known only to the year still look like full dates (F-DATE-PRECISION), so the year is reliable but finer parts may not be.  (R-YEAR)
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of instrument (P1303), date of birth (P569), place of birth (P19): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)
  * [scope] A ?player can appear in several rows: once for each value of ?birthyear, ?placeLabel.  (R-MULT-PER-ENTITY)
  * [display] Rows where ?birthyear is blank sort first.  (R-ORDER-UNBOUND)

    BIND(if(bound(?item__label_value), ?item__label_value, if(( isURI(?item) && strstarts(str(?item), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?item), "entity/"), str(?item))) AS ?itemLabel)

SELECT ?link (MIN(?image) AS ?img) ?qLabel (COUNT(DISTINCT ?sitelink) AS ?linkcount) WHERE {
  ?q (wdt:P31/wdt:P279*) wd:Q87167.
  FILTER (?q != wd:Q145780) # Exclude Dead Sea Scrolls: too broad
  ?sitelink schema:about ?q.

PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>

SELECT DISTINCT  (URI(concat("https://tools.wmflabs.org/reasonator/?q=", substr(str(?creator), 32))) AS ?reasonator) ?creatorLabel (GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ?locLabel ; separator=', ') AS ?locations) ?countryLabel (COUNT(?item) AS ?count)
WHERE
  { ?item wdt:P31/(wdt:P361)? wd:Q164992
    VALUES ?rel { wdt:P170 wdt:P1774 }
    ?item  ?rel  ?creator
    FILTER ( ! contains(str(?creator), "wikidata.org/.well-known/genid") )
    OPTIONAL
      { ?creator  wdt:P27  ?country }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?creator  wdt:P937  ?loc }
    BIND(if(bound(?loc), ?loc, "unbound") AS ?loc__label_subject)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?loc__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?loc__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?loc__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?loc__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?loc__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?loc__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?loc__label_value), ?loc__label_value, if(( isURI(?loc) && strstarts(str(?loc), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?loc), "entity/"), str(?loc))) AS ?locLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?creator  rdfs:label  ?creator__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?creator__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?creator  rdfs:label  ?creator__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?creator__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?creator__label_value), ?creator__label_value, if(( isURI(?creator) && strstarts(str(?creator), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?creator), "entity/"), str(?creator))) AS ?creatorLabel)
    BIND(if(bound(?country), ?country, "unbound") AS ?country__label_subject)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?country__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?country__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?country__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?country__label_subject
                  rdfs:label  ?country__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?country__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?country__label_value), ?country__label_value, if(( isURI(?country) && strstarts(str(?country), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?country), "entity/"), str(?country))) AS ?countryLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?creator ?creatorLabel ?countryLabel
ORDER BY DESC(?count)
queries.titleDirective: Profiles of astrolabe creators
queries.explanation:
One row per distinct combination of ?creator, ?creatorLabel, ?countryLabel.
Columns:
  ?reasonator: the web address (IRI) made from the text "https://tools.wmflabs.org/reasonator/?q=" + the part of the text of ?creator starting at character 32 joined together
  ?creatorLabel: the label of ?creator in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?locations: all values, joined, of distinct ?locLabel — blank for a group where ?locLabel never has a value
  ?countryLabel: the label of ?country in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?count: the number of ?item
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?item reaches astrolabe (Q164992 — astronomical instrument in the form of a disc or sphere with wires, cutouts or perforations that allows a user to calculate astronomical positions precisely) by following wdt:P31/wdt:P361? (each step a separate link)  [R-PATH]
  - ?item has ?creator as its creator (P170) or workshop of (P1774) (?rel)  [R-VALUES-PRED]
  - keeps only results where not (the text of ?creator contains "wikidata.org/.well-known/genid" (case-sensitive))  [R-FILTER]
Optional:
  - ?country filled in if ?creator has country of citizenship (P27) ?country, otherwise left blank  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?loc filled in if ?creator has work location (P937) ?loc, otherwise left blank  [R-OPTIONAL]
Grouping: by ?creator, ?creatorLabel, ?countryLabel.
Order: ?count descending.
Rows are deduplicated (DISTINCT).
Caveats:
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?creator, ?creatorLabel, ?countryLabel, so a ?creator with several ?country values appears once for each (each distinct ?countryLabel).  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping includes the label column ?countryLabel; things with identical labels are merged into one group.  (R-GROUP-BY-LABEL)
  * [changes_answer] ?count counts matching rows, not distinct ?item. ?item is counted once for each intermediate value along wdt:P31/wdt:P361? (R-MULT-PATH), and each listed value of ?rel that matches (VALUES).  (R-COUNT-ROWS)
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of instance of (P31), part of (P361), country of citizenship (P27), work location (P937): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)
  * [scope] Several items are labelled "astrolabe". This query uses Q164992 (astronomical instrument in the form of a disc or sphere with wires, cutouts or perforations that allows a user to calculate astronomical positions precisely), not Q55867318 (item 49636 in the History of Science Museum, Oxford), or Q55867319 (item 39540 in the History of Science Museum, Oxford).  (R-AMBIGUOUS-LABEL)
  * [display] ?locations joins all values in the group with ", ", in no guaranteed order.  (R-GROUPCONCAT)

queries.rewritten:
PREFIX  p:    <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX  psv:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/value/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>
PREFIX  wdt:  <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/direct/>
PREFIX  wikibase: <http://wikiba.se/ontology#>

SELECT DISTINCT  ?item ?itemLabel ?birthDate ?birthPrecision ?deathDate ?deathPrecision ?pic ?groupLabel (URI(concat("http://emlo.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/profile/person/", SAMPLE(?emlo))) AS ?emlolink)
WHERE
  { ?item  wdt:P1802  ?emlo ;
           wdt:P463   ?group
      { ?group wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)? wd:Q955824 }
    UNION
      { ?group wdt:P31/(wdt:P279)? wd:Q748019 }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  wdt:P18  ?pic }
    ?item p:P569/psv:P569 ?birthDateNode .
    ?birthDateNode
              wikibase:timeValue    ?birthDate ;
              wikibase:timePrecision  ?birthPrecision
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item p:P570/psv:P570 ?deathDateNode .
        ?deathDateNode
                  wikibase:timeValue    ?deathDate ;
                  wikibase:timePrecision  ?deathPrecision
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?item  rdfs:label  ?item__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?item__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?item__label_value), ?item__label_value, if(( isURI(?item) && strstarts(str(?item), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?item), "entity/"), str(?item))) AS ?itemLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?group  rdfs:label  ?group__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?group__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?group  rdfs:label  ?group__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?group__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?group__label_value), ?group__label_value, if(( isURI(?group) && strstarts(str(?group), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?group), "entity/"), str(?group))) AS ?groupLabel)
  }
GROUP BY ?item ?itemLabel ?birthDate ?birthPrecision ?deathDate ?deathPrecision ?pic ?groupLabel
queries.explanation:
One row per distinct combination of ?item, ?itemLabel, ?birthDate, ?birthPrecision, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision, ?pic, ?groupLabel.
Columns:
  ?item: always has a value
  ?itemLabel: the label of ?item in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?birthDate: always has a value
  ?birthPrecision: always has a value
  ?deathDate: may be blank
  ?deathPrecision: may be blank
  ?pic: may be blank
  ?groupLabel: the label of ?group in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?emlolink: the web address (IRI) made from the text "http://emlo.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/profile/person/" + one (arbitrary) value of ?emlo joined together
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?item has Early Modern Letters Online person ID (P1802) ?emlo  [R-TRUTHY]
  - ?item has member of (P463) ?group  [R-TRUTHY]
  - either [?group reaches learned society (Q955824 — organization that exists to promote an academic discipline or profession) by following wdt:P31/wdt:P279? (each step a separate link)] or [?group reaches scientific society (Q748019 — society dealing with a special field of science) by following wdt:P31/wdt:P279? (each step a separate link)]  [R-UNION]
  - ?item reaches ?birthDateNode by following p:P569/psv:P569  [R-PATH]
  - ?birthDateNode time value (wikibase:timeValue) ?birthDate  [R-TRIPLE]
  - ?birthDateNode time precision (wikibase:timePrecision) ?birthPrecision  [R-TRIPLE]
Optional:
  - ?pic filled in if ?item has image (P18) ?pic, otherwise left blank  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?deathDateNode, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision filled in if ?item reaches ?deathDateNode by following p:P570/psv:P570; ?deathDateNode time value (wikibase:timeValue) ?deathDate; ?deathDateNode time precision (wikibase:timePrecision) ?deathPrecision, otherwise left blank  [R-OPTIONAL]
Grouping: by ?item, ?itemLabel, ?birthDate, ?birthPrecision, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision, ?pic, ?groupLabel.
Rows are deduplicated (DISTINCT).
Caveats:
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?item, ?itemLabel, ?birthDate, ?birthPrecision, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision, ?pic, ?groupLabel, so a ?item with several ?birthDate values appears once for each.  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?item, ?itemLabel, ?birthDate, ?birthPrecision, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision, ?pic, ?groupLabel, so a ?item with several ?birthPrecision values appears once for each.  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?item, ?itemLabel, ?birthDate, ?birthPrecision, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision, ?pic, ?groupLabel, so a ?item with several ?deathDate values appears once for each.  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?item, ?itemLabel, ?birthDate, ?birthPrecision, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision, ?pic, ?groupLabel, so a ?item with several ?deathPrecision values appears once for each.  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?item, ?itemLabel, ?birthDate, ?birthPrecision, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision, ?pic, ?groupLabel, so a ?item with several ?pic values appears once for each.  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping is by ?item, ?itemLabel, ?birthDate, ?birthPrecision, ?deathDate, ?deathPrecision, ?pic, ?groupLabel, so a ?item with several ?group values appears once for each (each distinct ?groupLabel).  (R-GROUP-KEY-MULT)
  * [changes_answer] Grouping includes the label column ?groupLabel; things with identical labels are merged into one group.  (R-GROUP-BY-LABEL)
  * [scope] The date of birth (P569) statements here are of any rank, including deprecated ones (F-RANK-VALUES).  (R-FULLSTMT)
  * [scope] The date of death (P570) statements here are of any rank, including deprecated ones (F-RANK-VALUES).  (R-FULLSTMT)
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of Early Modern Letters Online person ID (P1802), member of (P463), instance of (P31), subclass of (P279), image (P18): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)
Labels: ?itemLabel from en → mul → ID; ?groupLabel from en → mul → ID.
Translation: rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.

PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>

SELECT  ?person ?personLabel (URI(concat("http://emlo.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/profile/person/", ?emlo1)) AS ?emlolink1) (URI(concat("http://emlo.bodleian.ox.ac.uk/profile/person/", ?emlo2)) AS ?emlolink2)
WHERE
  { ?person  wdt:P1802  ?emlo2 ;
             wdt:P1802  ?emlo1
    FILTER ( ?emlo1 > ?emlo2 )
    OPTIONAL
      { ?person  rdfs:label  ?person__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?person__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?person  rdfs:label  ?person__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?person__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?person__label_value), ?person__label_value, if(( isURI(?person) && strstarts(str(?person), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?person), "entity/"), str(?person))) AS ?personLabel)
  }
ORDER BY ?personLabel

queries.title: EMLO identifiers to Wikipedia pages
queries.explanation:
Columns:
  ?emlolink: always has a value
  ?wp: always has a value
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?entity has Early Modern Letters Online person ID (P1802) ?emlolink  [R-TRUTHY]
  - ?wp is if ?enwp has a value then ?enwp else if ?dewp has a value then ?dewp else if ?frwp has a value then ?frwp else if ?itwp has a value then ?itwp else if ?ruwp has a value then ?ruwp else if ?svwp has a value then ?svwp else ""  [R-BIND]
  - keeps only results where ?wp ≠ ""  [R-FILTER]
Optional:
  - ?enwp filled in if ?enwp is a wiki page about ?entity; wiki page ?enwp is on <https://en.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?dewp filled in if ?dewp is a wiki page about ?entity; wiki page ?dewp is on <https://de.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?frwp filled in if ?frwp is a wiki page about ?entity; wiki page ?frwp is on <https://fr.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]

  - ?ruwp filled in if ?ruwp is a wiki page about ?entity; wiki page ?ruwp is on <https://ru.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]
  - ?svwp filled in if ?svwp is a wiki page about ?entity; wiki page ?svwp is on <https://sv.wikipedia.org/>, otherwise left blank — at most one such page per wiki (F-SITELINK-UNIQUE)  [R-OPTIONAL]
Caveats:
  * [changes_answer] Identical rows can appear more than once: one for each matching ?entity (R-MULT-VALUE).  (R-MULT-DUP)
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of Early Modern Letters Online person ID (P1802): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)

        FILTER ( lang(?lang__label_value) = "mul" )

    BIND(if(bound(?lang__label_value), ?lang__label_value, if(( isURI(?lang) && strstarts(str(?lang), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?lang), "entity/"), str(?lang))) AS ?langLabel)
  }

queries.title: Types of hillfort
queries.rewritten:
PREFIX  p:    <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/>
PREFIX  pr:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/reference/>
PREFIX  prov: <http://www.w3.org/ns/prov#>
PREFIX  ps:   <http://www.wikidata.org/prop/statement/>
PREFIX  rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX  schema: <http://schema.org/>
PREFIX  wd:   <http://www.wikidata.org/entity/>

SELECT  ?type ?typeLabel ?typeDescription ?link
WHERE
  { ?type  p:P279   ?s .
    ?s     ps:P279  wd:Q744099 .
    ?s prov:wasDerivedFrom/pr:P854 ?link
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "en" )
      }
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  rdfs:label  ?type__label_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__label_value) = "mul" )
      }
    BIND(if(bound(?type__label_value), ?type__label_value, if(( isURI(?type) && strstarts(str(?type), "http://www.wikidata.org/entity/") ), strafter(str(?type), "entity/"), str(?type))) AS ?typeLabel)
    OPTIONAL
      { ?type  schema:description  ?type__description_value
        FILTER ( lang(?type__description_value) = "en" )
      }
    BIND(?type__description_value AS ?typeDescription)
  }
queries.explanation:
Columns:
  ?type: always has a value
  ?typeLabel: the label of ?type in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?typeDescription: the description of ?type in the first of en that has one; blank otherwise
  ?link: always has a value
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?s is a subclass of (P279) statement of ?type (any rank)  [R-FULLSTMT]
  - hillfort (Q744099 — type of earthworks used as a fortified refuge or defended settlement) is the main value of statement ?s  [R-FULLSTMT]
  - ?s has prov:wasDerivedFrom some value that itself has reference URL (P854) ?link  [R-PATH]
Caveats:
  * [changes_answer] Identical rows can appear more than once: one for each subclass of (P279) statement ?s (R-MULT-VALUE), and each intermediate value along prov:wasDerivedFrom/pr:P854 (R-MULT-PATH).  (R-MULT-DUP)
  * [scope] ?s ranges over every subclass of (P279) statement of any rank, including deprecated ones (F-RANK-VALUES).  (R-FULLSTMT)
  * [scope] A ?type can appear in several rows: once for each value of ?link.  (R-MULT-PER-ENTITY)
Labels: ?typeLabel from en → mul → ID.

  ?itemLabel: the label of ?item in the first of en, mul that has one; otherwise its ID
  ?link: always has a value
Conditions (all must hold):
  - ?item has heritage designation (P1435) Memory of the World (Q473858 — documentary heritage of worldwide importance, initiative launched by UNESCO)  [R-TRUTHY]
  - ?link is a wiki page about ?item  [R-SITELINK]
  - ?link language (schema:inLanguage) ?langcode  [R-TRIPLE]
  - ?langname is the first available of ?langlabel, ?langcode  [R-BIND]
  - keeps only results where the text of ?link contains ".wikipedia.org/" (case-sensitive)  [R-FILTER]
Optional:
  - ?language, ?langlabel filled in if ?language has ISO 639-1 code (P218) ?langcode; ?langlabel is a label (rdfs:label) of ?language, otherwise left blank (only where the language tag of ?langlabel = "en")  [R-OPTIONAL]
Order: ?langname ascending, then ?itemLabel ascending.
Caveats:
  * [scope] Uses only best-ranked values (F-RANK) of heritage designation (P1435), ISO 639-1 code (P218): preferred-rank statements if any exist, otherwise normal-rank; deprecated statements are ignored.  (R-TRUTHY)
Labels: ?itemLabel from en → mul → ID.
Author notes:
  "only Wikipedia articles"  — after: FILTER(CONTAINS(str(?link), ".wikipedia.org/"))
  "Convert short code to full language name"  — after: OPTIONAL { ?language wdt:P218 ?langcode; rdfs:label ?langlabel FILTER(lang(?langlabel) = "en") }
Translation: rewrite-wikibase-label-service/automatic.
